sql: (SELECT 'msg' AS tipo, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS hora, m.from_me::text AS from_me, left(m.content, 45) AS texto, m.message_id AS id, coalesce(m.metadata::text, '') AS info, to_char(m.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS gravado FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.remote_jid LIKE '5511996472316%' AND m.timestamp BETWEEN '2026-10-17T15:49:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T15:55:00Z') UNION ALL (SELECT 'raw', to_char(r.received_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS'), r.from_me::text, coalesce(r.event_type, '') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.processing_status, '') || ' / ' || coalesce(r.processing_note, ''), r.message_id, coalesce(r.error, ''), '' FROM wapi_webhook_raw_events r WHERE r.remote_jid LIKE '5511996472316%' AND r.received_at BETWEEN '2026-10-17T15:49:00Z' AND '2026-10-17T15:55:00Z') ORDER BY 2
